title: 2022 CODATA: reduced Planck constant is 1.054 571 817... × 10^−34
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks reduced Planck constant as exact: 1.054 571 817...
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks reduced Planck constant as exact: 1.054 571 817... × 10^−34 J s. The ellipsis is in the file. No further digits are added here. The reduced Planck constant is h divided by 2π. The listing marks it exact and keeps an ellipsis, so this card does not invent digits past the file.
